Dear John Doe,

Thank you for your interest in the position and for taking the time to submit your application.

After careful review, we regret to inform you that your profile does not fully align with the requirements for this role at this time.

John Doe is a graphic design graduate with entry-level retail and spa sales experience. His background is entirely in consumer-facing, part-time or junior roles (sales associate, spa consultant, fashion representative), with no relevance to the VP of Enterprise Sales position at ACME. The role demands 12+ years of progressive B2B enterprise sales experience, at least 5 years in VP-level leadership, management of 60+ person sales teams, and accountability for $180M+ ARR — none of which are present in this CV. The candidate does not meet a single required qualification for this executive-level position. This is not a match.

We encourage you to apply for future openings that may better match your qualifications.

Best regards,
HR Team

Dear Sarah Vaugier,

Thank you for your interest in the position and for taking the time to submit your application.

After careful review, we regret to inform you that your profile does not fully align with the requirements for this role at this time.

Sarah Vaugier is a highly experienced Senior Gemologist and Luxury Appraiser with a strong background in gemstone identification, luxury goods valuation, and auction house operations. However, her profile is entirely misaligned with the Vice President of Enterprise Sales role at ACME. She has no experience in B2B technology sales, SaaS, CRM, or enterprise software markets. She does not meet any of the required qualifications for this position — including VP-level sales leadership, managing large sales teams, or owning significant ARR quotas. Her geographic location (London, UK) also presents a mismatch for a North America-focused hybrid role based in San Francisco. This CV appears to have been submitted to the wrong job posting. The match score is 2/100, reflecting only the most superficial commonality of having professional experience and some team-facing responsibilities.

We encourage you to apply for future openings that may better match your qualifications.

Best regards,
HR Team
